nearest_robust_case.title: The MICROWAVE_ Background Radiation in the Direction Toward Clusters of Galaxies

interpretation: Most low-early/high-late papers in the random cohort are weak late upticks rather than robust delayed-recognition cases.
Only one of 22 unconfirmed candidates passed both the sleep/wake trajectory gate and the provisional high-B gate.
That near-miss failed only the prespecified total-recognition floor, with 29 citations through the observation endpoint.
The recognition floor is therefore preventing sudden but still low-volume citation bursts from being promoted to robust mechanism cases.
decision: Retain the near-miss for sensitivity/manual review; do not lower the primary recognition floor post hoc. Switch Track M case acquisition to SciSciNet-v2 case enrichment.
claim_boundary: OpenAlex B threshold remains provisional and is not calibrated to the OpenAlex B distribution.
